lore.text: Fair Flyer, Soirée, Matinée, Morning Mimosa and Fun Raiser are the Mare Fair mascots, visiting Ponyville. They are the convention's mascots, not a one-year cast. They stay at their camp, the Mare Fair Tent, a big striped tent by the road on the edge of Ponyville, with the parked Mare Fair balloon beside it, not Twilight's flyable balloon. They all sleep in the tent. Fair Flyer is a pegasus who organises the event. Soirée is a blunt earth pony and Matinée is her bubbly pegasus twin. Morning Mimosa is an eccentric earth pony. Fun Raiser is a unicorn who introduces ponies who need something to ponies who have it, and mixes drinks at night. They are guests. Do not invent a past with them that has not been witnessed.
